name: jsmydata-monorepo
description: JsMyData — administration web de bases MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL et SQLite, alternative React/Express à phpMyAdmin

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @jsmydata/server & npm run dev --workspace @jsmydata/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @jsmydata/web && npm run build --workspace @jsmydata/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/sql && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
